description: A mixer in two banks of three whose routing changes with which outputs are patched, dividing the sum by the number of patched inputs

inputs.text: One of the three inputs summed into OUTPUT 1 whenever OUTPUT 1 is patched, and into OUTPUT 2 when OUTPUT 1 is empty
One of the three inputs summed into OUTPUT 2, and dropped entirely when OUTPUT 1 is patched and OUTPUT 2 is not

outputs.text: INPUT 1, INPUT 2 and INPUT 3 summed and divided by the number of patched inputs
INPUT 4, INPUT 5 and INPUT 6 summed while OUTPUT 1 is patched, or all six inputs summed while it is empty, divided by the number of patched inputs

notes: what is mixed depends on which outputs are patched: OUTPUT 2 alone takes all six inputs, OUTPUT 1 alone takes inputs 1 to 3 and drops the rest, and with both patched the two banks stay apart
the sum is divided by the number of patched inputs, so patching another cable makes every input already there quieter
with both outputs patched the divisor counts only the cables in INPUT 1 to INPUT 3 but is applied to both outputs, so INPUT 4 to INPUT 6 are scaled by a count that has nothing to do with them
with both outputs patched the polyphonic channel count is read only from INPUT 4 to INPUT 6, so a polyphonic cable in INPUT 1 to INPUT 3 is cut down to however many channels the lower bank has
the jacks are not specific to any one signal; audio, gates and slow control voltages all sum alike
